page.topic: Modular, prefabricated data centers enter the AI era and boldly go where no data centers have gone before
target_prompts: Why are prefabricated modular data centers needed for AI factories?
fan_out: What makes AI factory data centers harder to build than cloud data centers (scale, rack density, liquid cooling)?
What are the benefits of prefabricated UPS and switchgear power skids?
How does prefabrication apply to high-density liquid-cooled AI racks and IT pods?
How much faster or cheaper is prefabricated deployment versus stick-built?
What are the limitations or drawbacks of prefabricated modular data centers?

criteria.rationale: Biographical opening; the 'why' (density, scale, labor shortage) only emerges in later sections and the conclusion. H1 is a Star Trek pun. H2s open with history/context, no takeaways block.
Named author with stated 30-year experience; no sources, standards, third-party quotes or first-party data.
Context numbers are good (10 GW, 250 kW vs 10-20, 246/227 kW) but the prefabrication benefits that answer the prompt are unquantified; density below 1.0/100w; 'innovative'; CDU undefined.
First-hand history details and a parallel deployment sequence; thesis is consensus-level; no SE data; no audience-specific actions.
No key-takeaways block anywhere on the page.
Advisory voice, but pun H1, 'Spoiler alert', exclamatory close; no current limitations or when-not-to-use.
Seed answered; 3 of 5 fan-outs covered (challenges, power skids, liquid-cooled pod). Missing quantified speed/cost comparison and current limitations.
Mostly descriptive H2s and one benefit list, but 6-7 sentence paragraphs and back-references ('These criteria', 'So, there you have it'). Nothing hidden.
H1 topic is clear but ends in a pun/slogan. SEO title consistent (meta not captured). 4 of 5 content H2s descriptive ('A slow start' is not); none phrased as a buyer question.
Key concept named three ways (AI factory modular IT Pod / AI Pod / IT Pod); no SE offer named; third-party models identified; no contradictions.
Explanatory depth fits Education; no CTA naming an SE asset; Top picks are unrelated.
Recently published and current figures; no 'Updated' date so not 5.
